summary: The owner's rule for paying early on the card path cannot be implemented with Creem's live subscription API. R18-R27 for card are blocked; per the mission's own escalation trigger, implementation stopped rather than approximated.
what_the_owner_rule_requires: Card change from paid plan X to different paid plan Y charges the FULL price of Y today
The new plan's period starts today (not extended by X's remainder)
The unused- days value on X is emailed back, never charged as 'the difference'

update_behavior_values.proration-charge-immediately: Access changes now; only the PRORATED DIFFERENCE is charged immediately. This is precisely the behaviour the owner ruled out (mission WP8 note 1).
update_behavior_values.proration-none: Access changes now; NOTHING is charged today. Rule violated (customer pays nothing today, not the full price).

what_creem_actually_offers.period_reset: None of the three resets current_period_start_date to today; Creem's own example charges the difference now and the new plan price on the EXISTING next billing date, i.e. the period end does not move to today.
what_creem_actually_offers.conclusion: No Creem mechanism is known to us that charges the full new price today and restarts the period.

why_we_stop.mission_authorisation: MISSION.md WP8 escalation triggers: 'Neither means charge the full new price today and restart the period... If nothing does, say so and stop - do not approximate with proration-charge-immediately... and do not cancel and re-create a live subscription on your own judgement. That is a decision for the owner.'
forbidden_approximations: Charging the difference (the exact failure mode the owner excluded)
Cancelling the live Creem subscription and creating a new one on our own judgement (risks the card double-charge trap / two live subscriptions; owner decision required)

what_is_needed_to_unblock: Either confirm with Creem (paid plan/limit vary) whether full-price restart exists beyond the three documented update_behavior values, or

The product owner decides the card mechanism: e.g. owner-approved cancel-and-recreate, a one-time charge on top of the old subscription (with its own double-subscription tradeoff), or keeping the current must_switch_instead refusal for card

Only after the owner decides: open the must_switch_instead refusal in plan_checkout_availability (billing.py:689), the second site at billing.py:1604, and the consent sentence at plan_changes.py:157-160 (currently a false promise: 'I am charged only the difference')
not_blocked_and_status: WP5 (unfinished payments) is implemented separately and does not depend on WP8
R13 (plan_is_on_sale refusal) is inside WP5 and lands with it
R28 page-vs-server agreement holds under the status quo because plan_checkout_availability was NOT changed (the review-page refusal C2-R1 landed and stays consistent)
test_integrity_note: No test was changed, skipped or deleted because of this escalation. The tests that assert the old card refusal (tests/integration/test_checkout_and_payment_email.py:881,1017 family) remain valid because WP8 did not land.
